name: 3-Phaser
description:
First-generation ERA Corp. vehicle. Designed and developed for fast, no-holds-barred races. The 3-Phaser is built for speed and manoeuvrability, while still being able to ram competitors.

Race Stats

Acceleration: 4d10 bonus to Manual + Driving/Mentality checks to execute speed bursts.

Manoeuvrability: 3d10 to Manual + Driving checks to execute sharp turns or complex manoeuvres in confined spaces.

Ramming damage: 1d6.

Turbo: 2 charges per Phase. Roll 1d100 to fast-recharge to regain 1 charge: on a 20 or lower, it gains one use but takes 3d6 damage; on a 85 or higher, it regains both charges. Using one charge allows the 3-Phaser to double its speed for one turn.

Turbo Discharge: When overtaking another vehicle, the 3-Phaser can use both its Turbo charges (if available) to double its speed AND deal 3d6 damage to any overtaken vehicles. If only one charge is available, the damage is 1d6. Overtaken vehicles can use a Reaction to make a Manual + Driving check to reduce the damage by 1d4 per Success on their roll.

name: RaCeMe
description:
A workhorse of no-holds-barred racing in the 2080s, the RaCeMe has many racecourse victories to its name. Some claim no other model has achieved the perfect balance between speed, manoeuvrability and bulk as the RaCeMe has.

Race Stats

Acceleration: 3d10 bonus to Manual + Driving/Mentality checks to execute speed bursts.

Manoeuvrability: 3d10 to Manual + Driving checks to execute sharp turns or complex manoeuvres in confined spaces.

Ramming damage: 2d6.

Turbo: 2 charges per Phase. Roll 1d100 to fast-recharge to regain 1 charge: on a 33 or lower, it gains one use but takes 3d6 damage; on a 85 or higher, it regains both charges. Using one charge allows the RaCeMe to double its speed for one turn.

Blinding: Powerful lights can blind a driver racing ahead of the RaCeMe. With direct line of sight on a vehicle at a maximum of 20 metres away from the RaCeMe. Any affected drivers must succeed on a Sense + Mentality check or lose all reactions until the the RaCeMe's next turn.

name: TK-39
description:
Tonka Katon made a reputation for itself as the most reliable maker of tanks during the One Hundred Years' War. Inevitably, its racing division manufactures some of the hardiest vehicles to have ever attained breakneck speeds. Though first designed in 2080, the TK-39 is still favoured by many racers in Neblir in the early 22nd Century.

Race Stats

Acceleration: 2d10 bonus to Manual + Driving/Mentality checks to execute speed bursts.

Manoeuvrability: 2d10 to Manual + Driving checks to execute sharp turns or complex manoeuvres in confined spaces.

Ramming damage: 3d6.

Turbo: 2 charges per Phase. Roll 1d100 to fast-recharge to regain 1 charge: on a 15 or lower, it gains one use but takes 3d6 damage; on a 75 or higher, it regains both charges. Using one charge allows the TK-39 to double its speed for one turn.

Tank: The TK-39 takes half ramming damage. If ramming as a result of a movement powered by the Turbo ability, the TK-39 doubles its ramming damage.

name: FIN-95
description:
The FIN-95 was designed with one goal in mind: winning races by sheer speed. Sleeker than many of its counter parts, it's developed to avoid ramming and accelerate out of trouble whenever it can.

Race Stats

Acceleration: 5d10 bonus to Manual + Driving/Mentality checks to execute speed bursts.

Manoeuvrability: 4d10 to Manual + Driving checks to execute sharp turns or complex manoeuvres in confined spaces.

Ramming damage: 1d6 (but it takes the damage it deals ramming).

Turbo: 3 charges per Phase. Roll 1d100 to fast-recharge to regain 1 charge: on a 15 or lower, it gains one use but takes 4d6 damage; on a 75 or higher, it regains both charges. Using one charge allows the FIN-95 to double its speed for one turn.

Light: It takes the same amount of damage it deals when ramming.

Auto-Evader: Once per turn, the driver can re-roll a failed Manoeuvrability check to avoid a ramming attack.

name: NasEd
description: A comfortable flying capsule from ERA Corp., the NasEd is a perfect first flying vehicle with excellent autopilot and inter-district range.

name: InfinityX
description: A family flying capsule from Infinity, spacious, perfect for long-distance travel as well as daily commutes.

name: PendPod
description: The PendPod is a reliable family vehicle that offers comfortable rides.

name: PersCap
description: Highly aerodynamic, sleek design. The PersCap is Persepolis' first approach at the individual flying capsule vehicle. It is praised for its design, manoeuvrability and speed, feature both state-of-the-art autopilot and manual controls.

name: S05_Fam-6H
description: The ultimate family ride from Alayo Corp. The S05_Fam series has been highly praised for the comfort of its spacious interior. The 6H is designed for a family of 6 to comfortably travel long distances across Neblir.

name: Swerve781
description: The Swerve781 is an all-rounder flying vehicle. A versatile flying capsule that can be the perfect choice for both short- and long-distance travel.

name: Snoder
description: The Snoder is an all-purpose snow land vehicle capable of sustaining long-distance travel away from Siike sources thanks to its multi-part tank for liquified Siike.
